messages:
maria: @neal @sophia quick heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8321 is ready but gated on a short design/arch spot-check. planning a canary tonight if we get a quick blessing. RFC link in follow-up.

maria: perf + test summary pasted below; most changes are around quantized routing fallback and KV-cache interaction.

jon: can you paste the RFC? also how big is the rollback surface if this has a regression? :eyes:

maria: RFC: https://redwood.ai/rfcs/897-quant-routing (internal). rollback is straightforward — traffic split flip + pin to int8-stable variant. main risk is stale KV cache causing misrouted long-prefix requests.

neal: I'll take a look now. timeline? can we get the key numbers (latency / p95 / cost delta) here?

maria: sure — small perf harness (simulated mixed sequence lengths):
```
baseline (fp16): p50=34ms p95=120ms tokens/s=180
int8_fallback: p50=36ms p95=130ms tokens/s=195
cost/unit delta: -12%
errors: none in 10k-req smoke
```

sophia: quick Q — does this change routing policy? earlier we had strict region affinity for stateful workloads.

maria: policy change is localized: only applies when GPU pool reports capacity_exhausted for model_variant and seq_len < 1024. region affinity still preferred; fallback preserves tenant isolation. snippet: 
```
policy:
  when: GPU_FULL
  route_to: int8_fallback
  conditions: [seq_len < 1024, tenant_tier != enterprise_restricted]
```

neal: ok. please add a short canary plan to the PR description and ensure the rollout uses automatic rollback on error-budget breach. also add a note in the RFC about TTL for KV cache eviction — that was my concern.

maria: added canary plan to PR: 5% traffic in us-west, 2h window, monitor p95/err-rate/cost. auto-rollback if p95 increases >15% or error-rate +5x. also adding RFC note about TTL.

jon: pinging infra to reserve a 9-11pm slot for canary. @deploy-bot any blockers?

deploy-bot: Staging deploy successful — build #8743 passed integration tests.

neal: I skimmed the RFC. please add one paragraph about stale-kv eviction strategy (TTL + eager invalidation on model-variant flip). after that and a tiny PR comment about a nil-check in router.go I'll +1.

maria: noted. I'll update RFC and drop the router.go fix in a follow-up commit. will tag you when done. thanks! :slightly_smiling_face:

sophia: thanks — will watch the canary dashboards during the window.

jon: thanks all. if no objections after neal's follow-up, we can merge and schedule canary tonight.

neal: one more thing — please add a short failure mode section to the RFC (what happens when KV cache TTL expires mid-request). small sentence will do.

maria: added the failure mode + TTL paragraph and pushed to RFC. pinging @neal for final glance.

neal: looks good to me now. +1 — go ahead with merge once CI green and canary slot confirmed.

maria: merging after CI. will post results in #eng-ml-canaries. thanks everyone! :rocket:
